consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : He said: "I am happy."
corrige: Introducteur passé → present « am » recule à « was ».
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he was happy.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : She said: "I work here."
exercices.reponse: She said (that) she worked there.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : He said: "I will call you."
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he would call you.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : She said: "I can help."
exercices.reponse: She said (that) she could help.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec say/tell : He ___ me that he was busy.
exercices.reponse: He told me that he was busy.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec say/tell : They ___ that it was late.
corrige: pas de complément de personne → say.
exercices.reponse: They said that it was late.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : They said: "We are tired."
exercices.reponse: They said (that) they were tired.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : He said me that he was late.
corrige: « say » n'a pas de complément de personne → tell.
exercices.reponse: He told me that he was late.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : She said she is ill.
corrige: Introducteur au passé → le temps recule : is → was.
exercices.reponse: She said she was ill.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : He said: "I saw her today."
corrige: saw reste au prétérit (pas de temps plus reculé demandé ici).
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he saw her that day.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Tom said: "I am hungry."
corrige: Introducteur au passé → « am » recule à « was ».
exercices.reponse: Tom said (that) he was hungry.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Anna said: "I like pizza."
exercices.reponse: Anna said (that) she liked pizza.

exercices.enonce: Indique si la phrase est au discours direct ou au discours indirect : Mia said that she was cold.
corrige: Il n'y a pas de guillemets, les paroles sont rapportées avec « that » et le temps a reculé (was).
exercices.reponse: Discours indirect.

exercices.enonce: Indique si la phrase est au discours direct ou au discours indirect : Ben said: "I am ready."
corrige: Les paroles sont citées mot pour mot, entre guillemets.
exercices.reponse: Discours direct.

exercices.enonce: Réécris la phrase en supprimant le mot « that » : He said that he was late.
corrige: Après « say », le mot « that » peut être supprimé sans changer le sens.
exercices.reponse: He said he was late.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : My parents said: "We are proud."
corrige: Introducteur au passé → « are » recule à « were ».
exercices.reponse: My parents said (that) they were proud.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Lucy said: "I will be there."
exercices.reponse: Lucy said (that) she would be there.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Sam said: "I will help my brother."
corrige: I → he et my → his (Sam est un garçon).
exercices.reponse: Sam said (that) he would help his brother.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Leo said: "I can't swim."
exercices.reponse: Leo said (that) he couldn't swim.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : The girls said: "We can dance."
exercices.reponse: The girls said (that) they could dance.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « say » ou « tell » au prétérit : She ___ her friend that the film was boring.
corrige: Il y a un complément de personne (her friend) → tell.
exercices.reponse: She told her friend that the film was boring.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « say » ou « tell » au prétérit : Our teacher ___ that the test was easy.
corrige: Pas de complément de personne après le verbe → say.
exercices.reponse: Our teacher said that the test was easy.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « say » ou « tell » au prétérit : I ___ them that I was sorry.
corrige: « them » est un complément de personne → tell.
exercices.reponse: I told them that I was sorry.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Ella said: "My cat is black."
exercices.reponse: Ella said (that) her cat was black.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Max said: "My sister lives in London."
exercices.reponse: Max said (that) his sister lived in London.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Jack said: "I am here now."
exercices.reponse: Jack said (that) he was there then.

exercices.enonce: Donne l'équivalent au discours indirect (introducteur au passé) de ces trois repères : here, now, today.
corrige: Les repères de lieu et de temps changent car on ne parle plus au même endroit ni au même moment.
exercices.reponse: here → there ; now → then ; today → that day.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Paul said: "I play football every Saturday."
exercices.reponse: Paul said (that) he played football every Saturday.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect (attention : le verbe introducteur est au présent) : Kate says: "I am tired."
corrige: Introducteur au présent (says) → le temps ne recule pas.
Seul le pronom change : I → she.
exercices.reponse: Kate says (that) she is tired.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect (attention : le verbe introducteur est au présent) : Tom says: "I will come."
corrige: Introducteur au présent → « will » ne change pas.
exercices.reponse: Tom says (that) he will come.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Emma said: "I won't be late."
exercices.reponse: Emma said (that) she wouldn't be late.

exercices.enonce: Corrige l'erreur : He told that he was hungry.
corrige: « tell » doit être suivi d'une personne ; sans personne, on emploie « say ».
On peut aussi ajouter une personne : He told me that he was hungry.
exercices.reponse: He said that he was hungry. (ou : He told me that he was hungry.)

exercices.enonce: Corrige l'erreur : She said she will come.
corrige: L'introducteur est au passé → « will » recule à « would ».
exercices.reponse: She said she would come.

exercices.enonce: Corrige l'erreur (Tom parle de lui-même) : Tom said that I was tired.
corrige: Au discours indirect, « I » de Tom devient « he ».
exercices.reponse: Tom said that he was tired.

exercices.enonce: Retrouve les paroles exactes au discours direct : Lisa said that she was happy.
corrige: On revient au présent : was → am.
she → I, et on remet les guillemets.
exercices.reponse: Lisa said: "I am happy."

exercices.enonce: Retrouve les paroles exactes au discours direct : He said he could ride a horse.
exercices.reponse: He said: "I can ride a horse."

exercices.enonce: Retrouve les paroles exactes au discours direct : They said they would visit Paris.
exercices.reponse: They said: "We will visit Paris."

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Jake and Ben said: "Our team is the best."
exercices.reponse: Jake and Ben said (that) their team was the best.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect en employant « tell » : Sarah said to me: "I am cold."
exercices.reponse: Sarah told me (that) she was cold.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect en employant « tell » : Mr Smith said to the pupils: "The bus will arrive at nine."
corrige: « said to the pupils » → « told the pupils ».
exercices.reponse: Mr Smith told the pupils (that) the bus would arrive at nine.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Olivia said: "I am busy today."
exercices.reponse: Olivia said (that) she was busy that day.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : Dan said: "I can't come now."
exercices.reponse: Dan said (that) he couldn't come then.

exercices.enonce: Remets la phrase dans le bon ordre et corrige-la : She told she was sad to her mum.
corrige: Avec « tell », la personne se place juste après le verbe : told her mum.
Puis viennent les paroles rapportées : (that) she was sad.
exercices.reponse: She told her mum (that) she was sad.

exercices.enonce: Traduis en anglais : Il a dit qu'il était fatigué.
corrige: Pas de complément de personne → said.
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he was tired.

exercices.enonce: Traduis en anglais : Elle m'a dit qu'elle pouvait venir.
corrige: « m'a dit » : complément de personne → told me.
exercices.reponse: She told me (that) she could come.

exercices.enonce: Traduis en anglais : Ils ont dit qu'ils viendraient.
corrige: Pas de complément de personne → said.
exercices.reponse: They said (that) they would come.

exercices.enonce: Mets les deux phrases de Nina au discours indirect : Nina said: "I am new here. I don't know anyone."
corrige: am → was ; here → there ; I → she.
don't know → didn't know ; on relie les deux idées avec « and ».
exercices.reponse: Nina said (that) she was new there and (that) she didn't know anyone.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect en employant « tell » : Tom said to his mother: "I will clean my room."
corrige: said to his mother → told his mother.
will → would ; I → he ; my → his.
exercices.reponse: Tom told his mother (that) he would clean his room.

exercices.enonce: Amy dit : "I can't find my keys." Rapporte ses paroles en commençant par « Amy said ».
exercices.reponse: Amy said (that) she couldn't find her keys.

exercices.enonce: Mets au discours indirect : The twins said: "We live here and we love our town."
corrige: we → they ; our → their ; here → there.
exercices.reponse: The twins said (that) they lived there and (that) they loved their town.
